cause_quote: The migration added `if (!isSupported()) {` using `@openclaw/proc-safe/reaper` before the process-group scan, so the first cancellation could trigger a whole-process report even when there was no zombie to reap.
user_saw: The first cancellation of a Linux command with no child processes could briefly delay the Gateway.
summary: The fix defers the native reaper support check until a fresh process-group scan finds an adopted direct-child zombie.
reasoning: I checked the migration diff and its parent: Linux command cancellation already used this cleanup path, and its eager check loaded Koffi and bound `waitpid`. The fix PR's before-and-after measurements tie the whole-process report to the new proc-safe check, but they do not measure the older Koffi path.
